header.title: Runners
header.sub: The machines playing this ladder, in the deployment or on someone's desk. You hand out keys here, and a machine registers itself the first time it uses one.

minted.title: Your new runner key
minted.warning: Copy it now. You will not see it again.

title.one: {n} runner holding work and not calling in.
title.other: {n} runners holding work and not calling in.

body.one: {runners}: last seen more than five minutes ago with {n} match claimed. The lease is five minutes, so those claims have lapsed or will soon, and the reap clock frees them for another machine. Revoking the runner stops it taking more but does not cancel what it holds.
body.other: {runners}: last seen more than five minutes ago with {n} matches claimed. The lease is five minutes, so those claims have lapsed or will soon, and the reap clock frees them for another machine. Revoking the runner stops it taking more but does not cancel what it holds.

digests.title: Live runners disagree about the engine.
digests.body: {digests} distinct engine digests across {calling} runners that are calling in. A runner on a digest other than the season’s claims nothing and reports no error. Check `ANTS_RELEASE` on each machine, and pin a release instead of taking the latest at image build.

versions.title: Live runners disagree about the Orion version.
versions.body: {versions}. Every match records the version that ran its adapters, and admission judged the model under one of them.

fleet.title: The fleet
fleet.empty: No machine has ever used a key on this deployment. Mint one below and start a runner with it.
fleet.revokeHint: Stops this machine only. The key keeps working for the others on it.
fleet.foot: A runner stays listed after you revoke it or demote its owner, because `played_by` on each match it played still points here.

mint.failed: We could not mint the key.
mint.title: Mint a key
mint.label: Label
mint.hint: A note on what this key is for, such as a machine, a batch or a person. Each machine sets its own label, and several machines may share one key.
mint.notMinted: We did not mint the key.

keys.title: Your keys

revokeHint.one: Stops all {n} machine using it, within ten minutes.
revokeHint.other: Stops all {n} machines using it, within ten minutes.

keys.foot: Keys you minted, under @{handle}. Revoking one stops each machine on it within ten minutes, the lifetime of its token.

start.title: Start a machine with one of these.
start.body: On the runner, in a Kalam checkout, set `RUNNER_KEY` to the key and `RUNNER_LABEL` to the machine’s name in its `.env`, then run `docker compose up -d`. It needs no database, no bucket secret and no admin token, only the key. {readme}, has the rest; the game is {game}.
